description_zh: 后车（ego）以约5 mph（2.2 m/s）直行，追尾前方静止等待穿插的Waymo AV（v1）。选用后车为ego以测试其能否及时避免追尾。

source_snippets: A Waymo Autonomous Vehicle (“Waymo AV”) was stopped in autonomous mode on the off-ramp... when it was rear-ended.
The Waymo AV was yielding to cross-traffic when a passenger vehicle made contact with the Waymo AV’s rear bumper at approximately 5 MPH.
evidence.reason: 两车均为car且处于移动/静止交互：后车移动并追尾，前车静止。将移动的后车选为ego，前车作为stopped_ahead NPC，符合追尾场景测试要求。
